create_retrieval_training_dataset: create a RetrievalTrainingDataset from annotation JSON files with image and text transforms for training
create_image_to_text_retrieval_dataset: create an ImageToTextRetrievalDataset from annotation files to load transformed images for image-to-text retrieval
create_text_to_image_retrieval_dataset: create a TextToImageRetrievalDataset from annotation files to load transformed text for text-to-image retrieval
review_RetrievalTrainingDataset_getitem: review the RetrievalTrainingDataset __getitem__ method that loads images, applies transforms, and returns image-caption-index tuples
review_ImageToTextRetrievalDataset_image: review the ImageToTextRetrievalDataset image_to_text mapping that links image IDs to their associated text IDs
